name: montessori-cms-security-rules-tests
description: Emulator-only positive/negative tests for firestore.rules, storage.rules and Auth account-status behavior (disabled/suspended users). See ../README.md and the repository root README's 'Testing' section — these need the Firebase Emulator Suite (JDK 21+) and are not run by any Dart/Node unit test command.

scripts.test:sequential: jest --runTestsByPath firestore.rules.test.ts && jest --runTestsByPath storage.rules.test.ts && jest --runTestsByPath auth.account-status.test.ts
scripts.test:against-emulators: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-montessori-2d --only auth,firestore,storage "npm run test:sequential"
